definitions.explanation: A person's former boyfriend. A casual, colloquial term common in conversation and on social media.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カレ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I got a message from my ex-boyfriend.
I'm still friends with my ex-boyfriend.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カレ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦したくない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I don't really want to talk about my ex-boyfriend.

notes:
Colloquial contraction of ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧ ('former boyfriend'), with カレ written in katakana. Common in casual speech and text messages.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{元|もと}カノ→元カノ：29939_motokano⟧: ex-girlfriend
- ⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧: boyfriend
- {元彼|もとかれ}: the same word written in kanji
